mapper.select: select count(1) from energy_dept_project where dept_id = #{deptId} and project_code = #{projectCode} and enabled = '1'
select id, dept_id as deptId, project_code as projectCode, enabled from energy_dept_project where dept_id = #{deptId} order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into energy_dept_project (dept_id, project_code, enabled, create_by, create_time) values (#{deptId}, #{projectCode}, #{enabled}, #{createBy}, now()) on duplicate key update enabled = '1', update_by = #{createBy}, update_time = now()
mapper.select:
select p.project_code as projectCode, p.project_name as projectName, p.route_name as routeName, v.version_code as versionCode, v.version_name as versionName, v.data_status as dataStatus, v.lifecycle_status as lifecycleStatus, v.content_sha256 as contentSha256, v.published_at as publishedAt from energy_project p join energy_project_version v on v.project_id = p.project_id
join energy_dept_project d on d.project_code = p.project_code and d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.enabled = '1'
order by v.published_at desc

select f.relative_path as relativePath, f.content_size_bytes as contentSizeBytes from energy_dataset_file f join energy_project_version v on v.version_id = f.version_id join energy_project p on p.project_id = v.project_id
join energy_dept_project d on d.project_code = p.project_code and d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.enabled = '1'
where p.project_code = #{projectCode} and v.version_code = #{versionCode} order by f.relative_path
select run_id from energy_run where status = 'pending' order by queued_at, run_id

select r.run_id as runId, r.run_type as runType, r.status, r.requested_by as requestedBy, r.error_message as errorMessage, DATE_FORMAT(r.queued_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as queuedAt, DATE_FORMAT(r.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startedAt, DATE_FORMAT(r.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as finishedAt, r.attempt_count as attemptCount, r.state_version as stateVersion, p.project_code as projectCode, v.version_code as versionCode from energy_run r join energy_project p on p.project_id = r.project_id join energy_project_version v on v.version_id = r.version_id
join energy_dept_project d on d.project_code = p.project_code and d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.enabled = '1'
and r.run_type = #{runType} and r.status = #{status} order by r.queued_at desc

select r.run_id as runId, r.run_type as runType, r.status, r.requested_by as requestedBy, r.code_version as codeVersion, r.input_sha256 as inputSha256, r.result_sha256 as resultSha256, r.error_count as errorCount, r.warning_count as warningCount, r.error_message as errorMessage, DATE_FORMAT(r.queued_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as queuedAt, DATE_FORMAT(r.started_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startedAt, DATE_FORMAT(r.finished_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as finishedAt, r.idempotency_key as idempotencyKey, r.attempt_count as attemptCount, DATE_FORMAT(r.lease_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as leaseExpiresAt, DATE_FORMAT(r.heartbeat_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as heartbeatAt, r.state_version as stateVersion, p.project_code as projectCode, v.version_code as versionCode from energy_run r join energy_project p on p.project_id = r.project_id join energy_project_version v on v.version_id = r.version_id where r.run_id = #{runId}
select p.project_code from energy_run r join energy_project p on p.project_id = r.project_id where r.run_id = #{runId}

select event_id as eventId, state_version as stateVersion, from_status as fromStatus, to_status as toStatus, reason, DATE_FORMAT(occurred_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as occurredAt from energy_run_state_event where run_id = #{runId} order by state_version
select * from energy_timetable_audit_summary where run_id = #{runId}
select * from energy_optimization_decision where run_id = #{runId}

select result_kpi_id as resultKpiId, run_id as runId, candidate_id as candidateId, case_name as caseName, feasible, total_gen_kwh as totalGenKwh, wasted_kwh as wastedKwh, grid_kwh as gridKwh, recovered_energy_kwh as recoveredEnergyKwh, recovery_rate as recoveryRate, constraint_violation as constraintViolation, resource_conflict_count as resourceConflictCount from energy_result_kpi where run_id = #{runId} order by case_name

select running_arc_id as runningArcId, train_id as trainId, train_type as trainType, direction, from_station_code as fromStationCode, to_station_code as toStationCode, start_time_s as startTimeS, end_time_s as endTimeS, traction_energy_kwh as tractionEnergyKwh, regen_energy_kwh as regenEnergyKwh from energy_timetable_running_arc where run_id = #{runId} order by start_time_s limit 500

select time_slice_id as timeSliceId, case_name as caseName, slice_start_s as sliceStartS, slice_end_s as sliceEndS, traction_kwh as tractionKwh, regen_kwh as regenKwh, wasted_kwh as wastedKwh, grid_kwh as gridKwh from energy_time_slice where run_id = #{runId} order by slice_start_s limit 500

select settlement_id as settlementId, power_arm_code as powerArmCode, window_start_s as windowStartS, window_end_s as windowEndS, wasted_kwh as wastedKwh, grid_kwh as gridKwh from energy_power_arm_settlement where run_id = #{runId} order by window_start_s limit 500
select issue_id as issueId, issue_type as issueType, severity, reason from energy_audit_issue where run_id = #{runId}
select suggestion_id as suggestionId, suggestion_type as suggestionType, reason, status from energy_optimization_suggestion where run_id = #{runId}

select candidate_id as candidateId, source_candidate_code as sourceCandidateCode, `rank`, feasible, pareto, wasted_kwh as wastedKwh, grid_kwh as gridKwh from energy_optimization_candidate where run_id = #{runId} order by `rank`

select a.train_id as trainId, a.train_type as trainType, a.adjustment_s as adjustmentS, a.baseline_departure_s as baselineDepartureS, a.optimized_departure_s as optimizedDepartureS from energy_candidate_train_adjustment a join energy_optimization_candidate c on c.candidate_id = a.candidate_id where c.run_id = #{runId} limit 500
select conflict_type as conflictType, severity, train_a as trainA, train_b as trainB, message from energy_resource_conflict where run_id = #{runId} limit 200
select scenario_name as scenarioName, feasible, blocking, constraint_violation as constraintViolation from energy_scenario_result where run_id = #{runId}

select event_id as eventId, cycle_index as cycleIndex, current_time_s as currentTimeS, commit_status as commitStatus, safety_state as safetyState, safety_action as safetyAction, core_robust_feasible as coreRobustFeasible, operational_intervention_required as operationalInterventionRequired from energy_rolling_control_event where run_id = #{runId} order by cycle_index

select relative_path as relativePath, artifact_type as artifactType, media_type as mediaType, content_size_bytes as contentSizeBytes, content_sha256 as contentSha256 from energy_result_artifact where run_id = #{runId} order by relative_path
select relative_path as relativePath, media_type as mediaType, content, content_sha256 as contentSha256 from energy_result_artifact where run_id = #{runId} and relative_path = #{relativePath}

select r.run_id as runId, DATE_FORMAT(r.queued_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as queuedAt, p.parameters_json as parametersJson from energy_run r join energy_run_parameter p on p.run_id = r.run_id join energy_project proj on proj.project_id = r.project_id join energy_project_version v on v.version_id = r.version_id
join energy_dept_project d on d.project_code = proj.project_code and d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.enabled = '1'
where proj.project_code = #{projectCode} and v.version_code = #{versionCode} and r.run_type = #{runType} order by r.queued_at desc, r.run_id desc limit 1

select d.storage_code as storageSectionId, d.initial_soc_kwh as socKwh, d.available as available, d.max_charge_power_kw as maxChargePowerKw, d.max_discharge_power_kw as maxDischargePowerKw from energy_storage_device d join energy_project_version v on v.version_id = d.version_id join energy_project p on p.project_id = v.project_id
join energy_dept_project dep on dep.project_code = p.project_code and dep.dept_id = #{deptId} and dep.enabled = '1'
where p.project_code = #{projectCode} and v.version_code = #{versionCode} order by d.storage_code
